title: A Echo for the Vector Again
author: Mara Joubert
blurb: Jude Whitlock, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
